name: Black Ash Teleport
description:
*In a swirl of black ash, you step from one place to another.*

**Maneuver** — Magic — Maneuver

**Distance:** Self   **Target:** Self

**Effect:** You teleport up to 5 squares. If you have concealment or cover at your destination, you can use the Hide maneuver even if you are observed. If you successfully hide using this maneuver, you gain 1 surge. Spend 1+ Insight: You teleport 1 additional square for each insight spent.
